title: Book 6 — Erato, Chapter 80
paragraphs: Cleomenes then ordered all the Helots to pile up brushwood around the sacred grove, and when they had done so, he set it on fire. As it was burning, he asked one of the deserters to which god the grove was sacred, and the man answered that it was sacred to Argos. When he heard this, Cleomenes groaned aloud and said, “Apollo, god of oracles, you have surely deceived me badly, saying that I should conquer Argos. I now suspect that the oracle has already been fulfilled for me.”
